name: Classic Telecom Churn Dataset
collection_method: Churned customers (minority class) ki sankhya non-churned customers ke muqable kaafi kam (~14%) hai, jisse model prediction mein bias aa sakta hai.
known_limitations: Yes. This is a fully labelled dataset designed for supervised binary classification. The target column Churn indicates whether a customer left the service (Yes / 1) or remained active (No / 0).
audit_findings: class '0.0' holds 85.9% of the rows -- accuracy is misleading; judge by macro-F1 and per-class recall.
protected attribute column(s) ['phone_number'] were dropped before training (DROP_SENSITIVE_FEATURES) -- no fairness audit was run for them.
